item.title: EU bans the destruction of unsold apparel, clothing, accessories and footwear
item.description:
📝 To help reduce this wasteful practice, the ESPR requires companies to disclose information on the unsold consumer products they discard as waste. The ban on destruction of unsold apparel, clothing accessories and footwear and the derogations will apply to large companies from 19 July 2026. item.title: An Enslaved Gardener Transformed the Pecan into a Cash Crop
item.description:

Antoine’s advancements in the propagation of pecan trees that produced high-quality pecans of reproducible form, then, resulted in these nuts being cultivated as a cash crop that could be mass produced. Thus, the effort to establish these successful pecan trees that were the foundation for American commercial pecan production was literally cut down.
